title: Do it !
text: Pickup was on time and without complication.  Our guide, Sandra, was wonderful at pointing out interesting observations regarding the landscape and history on our way to Montserrat.  The monastery and the natural landscape surrounding it are incredible.  The visit to a local, small, family operated vineyard was a pleasant surprise.  Very informative and charming tour of their operation, history, and, of course, the tasting was nice as well.
